# SYNTHETIC FIXTURES ONLY

All prices and exchange rates are invented. Familiar provider keys describe the
**shape being tested**, not acquisition from those providers. Nothing here proves
API behavior, legal rights or empirical coverage. EIA pages deliberately span a
small paging boundary; a test separately generates 5,001 synthetic rows in memory.
The diesel handoff is a declared manual CSV shape, not a verified WOB workbook layout.
Original candidate handoff files remain outside Git; their claims are not adopted.
